financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Public offering of common units and pre-funded units with warrants, closed Jan 15, 2026 (net proceeds are the prospectus estimate)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: We expect to receive net proceeds of this Offering, after deducting placement agent fees and estimated offering expenses, approximately $27.71 million, assuming no exercise of the Warrants.

warrants.quote: Each Warrant will entitle the holder to purchase one common share at an exercise price of $6.93.
Each Pre-funded Warrant will be immediately exercisable for one common share and will not expire prior to exercise.

next_catalyst.what: Interim overall survival analysis in the pivotal Phase 3 trial of Bria-IMT plus a checkpoint inhibitor in metastatic breast cancer
next_catalyst.quote: reiterated that an interim overall survival analysis in the pivotal Phase 3 trial is expected in the first half of 2026.
